Your task is summarize the modifications made in the patch.
Your summary should consist of two parts, modifications in each file and their relationships.

From 7f9f7c697474268d9ef9479df3ddfe7cdcfbbffc Mon Sep 17 00:00:00 2001
From: Chia-Ming Chang <chiamingc@synology.com>
Date: Thu, 2 Apr 2026 14:14:06 +0800
Subject: [PATCH] md/raid5: fix soft lockup in retry_aligned_read()

When retry_aligned_read() encounters an overlapped stripe, it releases
the stripe via raid5_release_stripe() which puts it on the lockless
released_stripes llist. In the next raid5d loop iteration,
release_stripe_list() drains the stripe onto handle_list (since
STRIPE_HANDLE is set by the original IO), but retry_aligned_read()
runs before handle_active_stripes() and removes the stripe from
handle_list via find_get_stripe() -> list_del_init(). This prevents
handle_stripe() from ever processing the stripe to resolve the
overlap, causing an infinite loop and soft lockup.

Fix this by using __release_stripe() with temp_inactive_list instead
of raid5_release_stripe() in the failure path, so the stripe does not
go through the released_stripes llist. This allows raid5d to break out
of its loop, and the overlap will be resolved when the stripe is
eventually processed by handle_stripe().

Fixes: 773ca82fa1ee ("raid5: make release_stripe lockless")
Cc: stable@vger.kernel.org
Signed-off-by: FengWei Shih <dannyshih@synology.com>
Signed-off-by: Chia-Ming Chang <chiamingc@synology.com>
Link: https://lore.kernel.org/linux-raid/20260402061406.455755-1-chiamingc@synology.com/
Signed-off-by: Yu Kuai <yukuai@fnnas.com>

diff --git a/drivers/md/raid5.c b/drivers/md/raid5.c
index 1f8360d4cdb7..6e79829c5acb 100644
--- a/drivers/md/raid5.c
+++ b/drivers/md/raid5.c
@@ -6641,7 +6641,13 @@ static int  retry_aligned_read(struct r5conf *conf, struct bio *raid_bio,
 		}
 
 		if (!add_stripe_bio(sh, raid_bio, dd_idx, 0, 0)) {
-			raid5_release_stripe(sh);
+			int hash;
+
+			spin_lock_irq(&conf->device_lock);
+			hash = sh->hash_lock_index;
+			__release_stripe(conf, sh,
+					 &conf->temp_inactive_list[hash]);
+			spin_unlock_irq(&conf->device_lock);
 			conf->retry_read_aligned = raid_bio;
 			conf->retry_read_offset = scnt;
 			return handled;
-- 
2.34.1

The patch fixes a soft lockup in the MD RAID5 driver `retry_aligned_read()` function. The issue occurred when an overlapped stripe was released via `raid5_release_stripe()`, which put the stripe on a lockless list (`released_stripes llist`). In the next raid5d iteration, the stripe was moved to the `handle_list` but then immediately removed again by `retry_aligned_read()` before `handle_stripe()` could process it, causing an infinite loop.

**Modifications:**
- **File:** `drivers/md/raid5.c`
  - In the failure path of `retry_aligned_read()` (when `add_stripe_bio()` returns false), replaced the call to `raid5_release_stripe(sh)` with a direct call to `__release_stripe(conf, sh, &conf->temp_inactive_list[hash])` under `device_lock`, using `sh->hash_lock_index` to select the appropriate inactive list.
  - The change ensures the stripe is placed on the temporary inactive list rather than the lockless `released_stripes` llist, directly under the protection of `device_lock`. This prevents the stripe from being re‑queued to `handle_list` and removed again, breaking the soft lockup loop. The overlap will be resolved when the stripe is eventually processed by `handle_stripe()`.

**Relationship:** The modification is isolated to one function within one file. It alters the stripe release mechanism in a specific error handling scenario to avoid a race between stripe release and re‑processing, which was the root cause of the infinite loop.
